title: 第一卷 第2643章 白子剑第一卷 第2642章 真理之剑
content_zh:
李家要开放诛仙剑阵图的消息，很快便传遍了光明圣城。
以往李家也曾对外开启过诛仙剑阵图，甚至对城中其他势力都开放过，但这一次却截然不同。
李家直接放开了诛仙剑阵图的核心位置，让各方势力的修行者都有机会直抵那剑意最为浓郁的核心之地。
当然，有机会并不意味着一定能成。
即便如此，消息一出，仍旧吸引了无数人前来。
各大势力的剑道天才闻风而动，如潮水般向着李家涌来。
林尘身在李家，得知三天后便要开启诛仙剑阵图，心中自然满是期待。
如今他已凝聚出三把真理之剑，正渴望借助诛仙剑阵图内的古老剑意，让自身剑道再作突破，念头一起，心绪便隐隐炽热起来。
开启之日终于到了，李家上空剑意未显，气氛便已紧绷如弦，各方天骄云集。
圣火宗和九阴宗的人一看到林尘，眼中便有明显的敌意浮现。
此前林尘斩杀了两宗诸多强者，搅得圣火宗与九阴宗鸡犬不宁，此刻仇人相见，那些人的杀意浓烈得几乎要凝成寒霜。
林尘却只是漠然扫了一眼，懒得理会。
诸多势力当中，凌霄剑门格外引人注目。
凌霄剑门以剑道修行为立宗之本，李家竟然连他们也一并开放，可见李家格局之恢宏。
换成其他宗门，绝不可能让凌霄剑门这种对剑道传承视若性命的势力去接触诛仙剑阵图。
凌霄剑门当中，缓步走出一位白衣男子，名唤白子剑。
此人身形修长，眉宇间带着一股倨傲，径直来到林尘面前，脸上露出一抹讥讽之色，不咸不淡地说道：“听说你是从外城来的？”
林尘只是投去一道冷漠的眼神，显然不愿与他多费口舌。
白子剑心中愈发不服，他向来眼高于顶，怎能容忍一个外城之人这般无视自己，当下继续自顾自地说道：“外城来的废物罢了，也敢建什么凌霄天庭。
你可知道，凌霄天庭这名字跟我凌霄剑门相冲？我凌霄剑门乃是内城的一流势力，你却在外城建一个凌霄天庭，不知道的人，还以为我凌霄剑门是你凌霄天庭的靠山呢。”

白子剑句句带刺，冷言冷语。
林尘闻言，目光又寒了几分。
凌霄剑门的存在他当然听说过，只是当初取名凌霄天庭时，全凭胸中一股凌霄之志，并未思虑太多。
如今白子剑在他面前上蹿下跳，林尘自然不会给他好脸色看。
“我凌霄天庭取什么名字，跟你有什么关系？”
林尘声音平淡，却自有一股不容侵犯的冷意。
白子剑冷哼一声：“你无非就是想借我凌霄剑门的威势，好让人以为你凌霄天庭是我们凌霄剑门的附属势力，别以为我不知道你的心思。”
“是吗？”
林尘脸色淡然，不急不缓地说道，“有没有可能是你想太多了？”
白子剑态度嚣张，浑然没把林尘放在眼里。
关于林尘近来在光明圣城创下的那些辉煌战绩，白子剑心中根本不屑承认。
content_en:
The news that the Li family was going to open the Immortal Killing Sword Formation soon spread throughout the Holy City of Light.
In the past, the Li family had opened the Immortal Killing Sword Formation to the outside world, even to other forces in the city, but this time it was completely different.
The Li family directly released the core position of the Zhuxian Sword Formation, allowing practitioners from all forces to have the opportunity to reach the core of the sword's strongest point.
Of course, having a chance doesn't mean it will happen.
Even so, as soon as the news came out, it still attracted countless people.
The swordsmanship geniuses from all the major forces took notice and rushed towards the Li family like a tide.
Lin Chen was in the Li family, and when he learned that the Immortal Killing Sword Formation would be opened in three days, he was naturally full of expectations.
Now he has condensed three swords of truth, and he is eager to use the ancient sword intention in the Zhuxian Sword Formation to make another breakthrough in his swordsmanship. With the thought, his mood becomes faintly hot.
The opening day has finally arrived. Even before the sword intent was revealed in the sky above the Li family, the atmosphere was already tense, with talented people from all over the world gathered.
As soon as the people from the Holy Fire Sect and Jiuyin Sect saw Lin Chen, there was obvious hostility in their eyes.
Lin Chen had previously killed many strong men from the two sects, causing the Holy Fire Sect and the Jiuyin Sect to become restless. Now that the enemies met, the murderous intent of those people was so strong that it almost turned into frost.
Lin Chen just glanced at it indifferently and was too lazy to pay attention.
Among the many forces, Lingxiao Sword Sect is particularly eye-catching.
The Lingxiao Sword Sect is based on the practice of swordsmanship, and the Li family actually opened it to them as well, which shows the grandeur of the Li family's structure.
If it were any other sect, it would never be possible for a force like Lingxiao Sword Sect, which values ​​the inheritance of swordsmanship as much as life, to come into contact with the Zhuxian Sword Formation.
From the Lingxiao Sword Gate, a man in white slowly walked out, his name was Bai Zijian.
This man was tall and slender, with a hint of arrogance in his brows. He came straight to Lin Chen, with a sarcastic look on his face, and said in a neutral tone, "I heard that you are from an outer city?"
Lin Chen just cast an indifferent look, obviously unwilling to waste any more words with him.
Bai Zijian became increasingly dissatisfied. He had always set his sights higher than his own. How could he tolerate a person from an outer city ignoring him like this? He continued to talk to himself: "It's just a waste from the outer city, but he still dares to build a heavenly palace.
Did you know that the name Lingxiao Tianting conflicts with my Lingxiao Sword Sect? Our Lingxiao Sword Sect is a first-rate force in the inner city, but you are building a Lingxiao Heavenly Court in the outer city. People who don’t know, think that my Lingxiao Sword Sect is the backer of your Lingxiao Heavenly Court. "
Bai Zijian's every sentence is thorny and his words are sarcastic.
When Lin Chen heard this, his eyes became a little colder.
Of course he had heard of the existence of Lingxiao Sword Sect, but when he named it Lingxiao Heavenly Court, he did not think too much because of the ambition of Lingxiao in his heart.
Now that Bai Zijian was jumping up and down in front of him, Lin Chen would naturally not give him a good look.
"What does the name of my Lingxiao Heavenly Court have to do with you?"
Lin Chen's voice was calm, but there was an inviolable coldness about it.
Bai Zijian snorted coldly: "You just want to borrow the power of my Lingxiao Sword Sect to make people think that you, Lingxiao Sword Sect, are an affiliated force of our Lingxiao Sword Sect. Don't think that I don't know your thoughts."
"Really?"
Lin Chen looked calm and said calmly, "Is it possible that you are thinking too much?"
Bai Zijian's attitude was arrogant and he didn't take Lin Chen seriously.
Bai Zijian didn't even bother to admit Lin Chen's recent brilliant achievements in the Holy City of Light.
